name: delhi-kanpur-insufficient-labels
why: The shipped live deployment has no station readings inside the Delhi-Kanpur corridor's forecast target windows. This fixture records that case so the insufficient-data path is exercised and its wording pinned, rather than being discovered in production.

labels.note: The nearest CPCB/OpenAQ station that could serve this axis is outside the corridor cells at the configured H3 resolution.

reasons_include: no pm2.5 station observation fell in the target window
